stories.headline: Kamara's laid up, and Devin Neal just staked the biggest claim in New Orleans.
stories.read: Alvin Kamara's nursing a sprained MCL and the Saints held him out of the season opener against Detroit, with the word around camp being he's out a month or better. Devin Neal steps in as the top backup behind Kendre Miller battling for the same touches, and either one just became the hottest claim on the open range if you missed out on Kamara. Don't let this critter sit on your bench, pardner, go stake it before the outfit next door beats you to it.

stories.headline: Ashton Jeanty rides into Week 1 on a busted ankle, and the whole saloon's holding its breath.
stories.read: The rookie the herd paid top dollar for is saddling up after all: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak confirmed Jeanty is a go against Miami despite that low ankle sprain he took in camp. A low sprain heals a lot faster than a high one, and Vegas wants their workhorse out there gettin' his reins full of touches from snap one. Ride him with confidence, but keep an eye on the sideline reports, a tender wing can still throw a wheel.

stories.headline: Malik Davis is done for the season, and Emari Demercado just found himself a vein of cheap gold.
stories.read: Cowboys back Malik Davis needs hip surgery and lands on IR for the rest of 2026, straight up and out of the picture. That clears the trail behind Javonte Williams for Emari Demercado, claimed off waivers from Kansas City and sitting at a measly one percent rostered while nobody's lookin'. If Williams so much as stumbles, Demercado's the fella who inherits the whole haul, go stake that claim on the open range before your leaguemates catch wise.
